meta.about: Level 3, Midtown: the roofs above a bright square and the square itself, Seventh Av and W 46 St, 11:52 PM, night. Bounds, zones, every collider, the points the game flow and the AI use, the four nav layers with their links, the guide's route graph and the art-side placements, written by the shared layout tool.
meta.name: Midtown
meta.readFrom: the hand-authored layout table tools/levels/layouts/midtown.py, not the web game

units.web: metres, seconds, radians; +Y up, north = -Z, east = +X (right-handed)
units.ue: centimetres, degrees; +Z up, X = east, Y = south (left-handed)

meta.conversion: ue (X, Y, Z) = web (x, z, y) * 100; ue yaw = atan2(web z, web x) of a direction = -rotationY of a prop, in degrees
meta.status: stage-1 data, unbaked: `nav.layers[*].grid` is absent until the engine bake (-run=MILevelBake) writes it; the game does not load this file yet (levels.json is unchanged)
notes: el: absent (midtown.md 7.2, 17.2): the loader must treat a missing `el` as no deck (MAPS.md E2); `build_level.py --el-fallback` writes a degenerate deck 250 m outside the bounds for today's loader.

nav: four layers (street plane, r1 14.0, r2 17.6, r3 21.2), the six links L1 to L6 as polylines and the spawn reach are written; the grids are the engine bake's (-run=MILevelBake). The scaffold and service-stair polylines are generated here from the towers' landings and flights; the bake re-derives them.
No Buzzard doorways on purpose (midtown.md 9.1): interior.doorways is empty.
The IPX truck's colliders are owner kind `truck`, noNav: out of the box world until all three reels are in (extraction.arrival afterAll, MAPS.md E10).
deviationsFromDesign: the scaffold's south guard leaves the shed-hop opening (D3) over the west column only (x -8..-5.4, 5.35 to 7.35 m): the design names the opening, not its width.

the sidewalk shed by the tower runs z 20.1..24.4 over the west sidewalk only (design: z 20..30, which would stand in the W 46 St roadway); its south end is guarded, its east edge is the D3 drop (3.2 m).

the Stand's tiers 1 to 5 are two wings (x 10..13, 19..22) around a front court at plaza level (x 13..19, z -29.2..-22): as drawn, tier 5 (top 2.15) stands in front of the booth's slot (1.0 to 2.0 m) and would hide it; the court lets Goons and the player see and fire through the slot.
Broadway's water barriers at z 17.6..18.2, south of the parked van (z 12..17.4).
g23 at (25, 0, 18.8) instead of (25, 0, 18): still 'behind the water barriers', which stand at z 17.6..18.2.
surfaces use audio.json's keys: the design's granite, gravel, bitumen, grating and steel (16.3) are concrete, asphalt, asphalt, metal and metal, so footsteps and impacts resolve.

enemySpawns.source: authored points (docs/unreal/maps/midtown.md). `layer` names the nav layer of a ground point; `overlooks` limits a roof point to players in those zones; `facing` is derived (toward the walkable cells it reaches in a straight line within 6 m for ground points, the centre of the level for air points): the game gives a new enemy its own yaw.

coverPoints.source: points 0.6 m out from the faces of solids 0.9 m or more tall that block shots, on a walkable cell of their layer, at least 1.2 m apart (the bake re-filters them with FMIBoxWorld)

nav.source: midtown.md 7.2, 16.3: four layers, the links L1 to L6 (read from nav step B), spawn reach, firing cells, the stranded rule. The grids are written by the engine bake with FMIBoxWorld's code: `grid` is absent until then.

guide.source: midtown.md 6.4: the route graph the guidance draws over (nearest unsecured reel by route length; to the extraction once all are in); within a layer the layer's own path search at run time, across layers these edges (stairs both ways, drops down only). The service stair and the drops cost 10 m more, so the scaffold is the drawn way down. D3 (the shed hop) is a free player choice, never drawn.
